tools.name: convert_date
tools.description:
Convert between Gregorian and Hebrew (Jewish) calendar dates.
- Gregorian → Hebrew: pass gregorian_date (YYYY-MM-DD). Add end_date to convert a whole range (max ~180 days).
- Hebrew → Gregorian: pass hebrew_year, hebrew_month, hebrew_day.
Set after_sunset=true when the Gregorian time is after sunset

tools.name: get_jewish_calendar
tools.description: List Jewish calendar events for a date range: holidays (major, minor, modern Israeli), Rosh Chodesh, fast days, special Shabbatot, weekly parsha, Omer count, molad, Yizkor, Yom Kippur Katan, daily-learning cycles (Daf Yomi, Mishna Yomi, Nach Yomi, Tanakh Yomi, Yerushalmi, Rambam, Chofetz Chaim), and

tools.name: get_shabbat_times
tools.description: Candle-lighting and havdalah times for the coming (or a specified) Shabbat and any Yom Tov that week, plus the parsha and holiday Torah readings, for a location.

tools.name: get_zmanim
tools.description: Halachic times of day for a location and date (or date range, max ~7 days recommended): alot hashachar, misheyakir, sunrise (netz), latest Shema and Tefilla (GRA and Magen Avraham), chatzot, mincha gedola/ketana, plag hamincha, sunset (shkia), bein hashmashot, tzeit hakochavim (several opinions), an

tools.name: get_torah_reading
tools.description: Torah and Haftarah readings for a date or date range: parsha or holiday name, each aliyah with verse ranges and counts, maftir, haftarah, and special readings. Supports Israel vs Diaspora and the triennial cycle.

tools.name: get_yahrzeit_dates
tools.description: Compute upcoming Gregorian dates for yahrzeits, Hebrew birthdays or Hebrew anniversaries from the original Gregorian date. Handles after-sunset, Adar in leap years, and Cheshvan/Kislev edge cases. Up to 10 entries at once.

tools.name: find_location
tools.description: Search for a city/place by name and get place ids, country and region. Use the returned id as the "location" argument of other tools when a city name is ambiguous.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description:
Fetch any text from the Jewish library by reference, in Hebrew/Aramaic and/or translation, aligned segment by segment.
Covers Tanakh, Mishnah, Talmud Bavli & Yerushalmi, Midrash, Rambam, Shulchan Arukh, commentaries (e.g. "Rashi on Genesis 1:1"), Siddur, Zohar, Chasidut, Musar, responsa and more.
Re

tools.name: get_texts_bulk
tools.description: Fetch many short references in one call (e.g. a list of verses or commentary lines). Returns Hebrew and English for each. Up to 30 references.

tools.name: resolve_name
tools.description: Autocomplete and identify a book title, reference, author, topic or person from partial, misspelled, transliterated or Hebrew input ("bava metzia", "bereishis", "ברכות ב", "Rambam"). Tells you whether the input is a valid reference and gives canonical names.

tools.name: parse_reference
tools.description: Validate and normalize a text reference: canonical English and Hebrew forms, the book it belongs to, its structure, and previous/next sections.

tools.name: find_references_in_text
tools.description: Scan free text (a dvar Torah, article, shiur notes) and detect every citation of a Jewish source in it (e.g. "Genesis 1:1", "Berakhot 2a", "Rambam Hilchot Shabbat 1:1"). Returns the matched spans and their canonical references.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Check the status/result of a background task (e.g. a long reference-detection job) by task_id.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description:
Full-text search across the entire Jewish library (texts), or across user-made source sheets. Hebrew or English queries.
- exact=true matches the exact word forms; default matching is lemmatized (finds grammatical variants).
- filters narrow by category/book path, e.g. ["Tanakh"], ["Talmud/Bavli"],

tools.name: get_commentaries
tools.description:
Get commentaries and other sources connected to a passage.
- With commentator (e.g. "Rashi", "Ramban", "Ibn Ezra", "Sforno", "Tosafot", "Or HaChaim", "Onkelos", "Kli Yakar"): returns that commentator's full text on the passage.
- Without commentator: lists all connected sources in a category ("Comme

tools.name: get_related_content
tools.description: Overview of everything connected to a passage: counts of linked sources by category and book, related topics, source sheets that use it, manuscript images, and related web articles. Use it to explore before drilling in with get_commentaries.

tools.name: get_text_versions
tools.description: List every available edition and translation of a book (language, version title, license, source). Use a version_title with get_text to read a specific translation.

tools.name: list_translations
tools.description: Without a language: list every language code that has translations in the library. With a language code (e.g. "fr", "es", "de", "ru", "yi", "lad"): list every book translated into that language with its version titles.

tools.name: get_manuscripts
tools.description: Images of manuscripts and early printed editions (e.g. Vilna Shas, Venice 1523, Munich manuscript) for a passage, with image and thumbnail URLs.

tools.name: get_random_text
tools.description: Get a random passage, optionally limited to specific books or categories (e.g. categories ["Tanakh"], titles ["Psalms", "Proverbs"]).

tools.name: get_passage_context
tools.description: Given one or more segment references (e.g. "Berakhot 2a:1"), return the full logical passage/sugya each belongs to.

tools.name: get_text_image
tools.description: Generate a shareable image (PNG) of a short passage, sized for a social platform.

tools.name: browse_library
tools.description: Browse the library's table of contents by category. With no path: top-level categories (Tanakh, Mishnah, Talmud, Midrash, Halakhah, Kabbalah, Liturgy, Jewish Thought, Tosefta, Chasidut, Musar, Responsa, Second Temple, Reference). With a path like "Talmud/Bavli/Seder Moed" or "Halakhah/Shulchan Arukh

tools.name: list_book_titles
tools.description: Search the list of all books in the library by (part of) an English or Hebrew title, optionally within a category path. Returns canonical titles with their category.

tools.name: get_book_info
tools.description: Metadata for a book: author(s), era, composition date and place, description, categories, alternative titles, section structure (e.g. Chapter/Verse, Daf/Line), chapter lengths, and alternate structures (e.g. parshiyot for Torah books). Optionally text availability counts.

tools.name: get_book_raw_index
tools.description: Full, unabridged index record for a book (complete schema tree, match templates, alternate structures). Use get_book_info for a friendly summary.

tools.name: get_author_works
tools.description: List the books written by an author. Pass the author slug (e.g. "rashi", "rambam", "ramban", "ibn-ezra", "rabbi-yosef-karo") — find slugs with resolve_name type AuthorTopic.

tools.name: get_library_statistics
tools.description:
Statistics:
- kind "word_count": number of words in a specific version of a book (needs title, version_title, language he/en).
- kind "links_between_categories": how many links connect two categories (e.g. Tanakh ↔ Talmud).
- kind "text_availability": raw availability counts for a book.

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: Look up a named term (parsha names, section names, holidays, etc.) with its Hebrew and English titles and alternate spellings, e.g. "Noach", "Bereshit", "Perek".

tools.name: dictionary_lookup
tools.description: Look up a Hebrew or Aramaic word in classic dictionaries (Jastrow, BDB, Klein, and others). Handles prefixes/inflected forms. Pass context_ref to disambiguate using the passage where the word appears.

tools.name: dictionary_autocomplete
tools.description: Autocomplete a partial Hebrew/Aramaic word against a dictionary ("Jastrow Dictionary", "Klein Dictionary", "BDB Augmented Strong").

tools.name: get_learning_schedules
tools.description: Today's (or any date's) study schedule items with exact references: Parashat HaShavua, Haftarah, Daf Yomi, 929, Daily Mishnah, Daily Rambam (1 and 3 chapters), Daf a Week, Halakhah Yomit, Arukh HaShulchan Yomi, Tanakh Yomi, Chok LeYisrael, Tanya Yomi, Yerushalmi Yomi, and more.

tools.name: get_parasha
tools.description: Details for a weekly Torah portion by name (e.g. "Noach", "Lech Lecha", "Ki Tisa"): full reference, aliyot, haftarah, and the next date it will be read.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: Get a curated topic — a person (e.g. "moses", "rambam", "rabbi-akiva"), concept ("teshuvah", "kindness"), holiday ("passover"), mitzvah or object — with its description and its top sources, ordered by importance. Use resolve_name (type "Topic") or search_topics to find slugs.

tools.name: search_topics
tools.description: List topics, optionally filtered by a word in the title. Without a filter returns the most prominent topics.

tools.name: get_topic_graph
tools.description: Get the network of topics connected to a topic (e.g. students/teachers of a sage, parts of a concept). Optionally restrict to one link type such as "is-a", "has-student", "has-teacher", "related-to", "part-of".

tools.name: recommend_topics
tools.description: Recommend topics relevant to one or more passages (e.g. for tagging a source sheet or finding themes in a set of verses).

tools.name: get_random_source_by_topic
tools.description: Get a random source together with the topic it illustrates — handy for a daily inspiration or quiz.

tools.name: get_seasonal_topic
tools.description: Get the curated topic for the current parsha (kind "parasha") or the current/upcoming holiday (kind "holiday"), with description and key sources.

tools.name: get_source_sheet
tools.description: Get a user-made source sheet by id: title, author, tags, and each source (reference + text) and commentary block in order. Pass several ids to fetch up to 10 sheets.

tools.name: list_source_sheets
get_sheet_tags
tools.description: Source-sheet tags: "trending" (this week's trending tags), "all" (every tag, sorted by count or alphabetically), or a specific user's tags.

tools.name: check_sheet_modified
tools.description: Check whether a source sheet has been modified since a timestamp (ISO date/time).

tools.name: get_collections
tools.description: Browse collections of source sheets: pass slug for one collection (with its sheets), user_id for a user's collections, or neither to list public collections (filterable by name).

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Public profile of a library user/author of source sheets, by profile slug (e.g. "dovid-birk").

tools.name: todays_learning
tools.description: One-call daily briefing: today's Hebrew date, holidays/events, the weekly parsha, and every daily learning schedule (Daf Yomi, Rambam, Mishnah, 929, Halakhah Yomit, Tanya, etc.) with exact references. Optionally include the opening lines of each study item.

tools.name: parsha_study_pack
tools.description: Everything to study the weekly Torah portion: the reading (for a date, or by parsha name), aliyot and haftarah, the text of a chosen aliyah (Hebrew + English), a commentator's notes on its opening verses, and the parsha's topic and themes. Great for preparing a dvar Torah.

tools.name: holiday_sources
tools.description: For the next (or a named) Jewish holiday: its dates, a description, the Torah/Haftarah readings, and key classical sources with text. Examples: "Sukkot", "Chanukah", "Purim", "Pesach", "Shavuot", "Tisha B'Av", "Rosh Hashana".

tools.name: shabbat_briefing
tools.description: A ready-to-read Friday summary for a location: candle-lighting and havdalah times, the parsha with aliyot and haftarah, the opening verse of the parsha in Hebrew and English, and any holiday that week.
